title: 1 - Bob Version 1.0
summary: Newly financially secure after selling his software business, Bob Johansson attends a science-fiction convention in Las Vegas and signs a cryonics agreement. Conversations with former colleagues and family touch on the breakup he is recovering from and the prospect of self-replicating space probes. Later, a car bears down on him in a crosswalk; pain, medical voices, and his fading awareness strongly indicate a fatal collision.

introducing.name: Bob's Road Incident
introducing.description: While Bob crosses a Las Vegas street, a car approaches, he experiences sudden pain, and medical and legal voices accompany his fading awareness. The sequence strongly suggests a collision and death, although neither is stated directly.

introducing.name: Robert Johansson
introducing.current_state: Presumed dead after the road incident.

introducing.name: CryoEterna Inc.
introducing.description: A cryonics provider that contracts with Bob for post-death preservation.

introducing.name: InterGator Software
introducing.description: Bob's software company, built around a successful engineering application and sold after attracting a large acquisition offer.

introducing.name: The Vortex
introducing.description: A three-day science-fiction convention where Bob attends discussions about extraterrestrial life and self-replicating interstellar probes.
